scenarios.name: update-customer-11-vsam-only
scenarios.why: customer 11 is on KSDSCUST (ksdscust-vsam-only.txt, appended) but not in Db2's CUSTOMER: the UPDATE is +100 (l.173 true), CA-RETURN-CODE '01', no '90' and no WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE; LGUCVS01 is still LINKed and its READ UPDATE / REWRITE of customer 11 are NORMAL -- the two stores out of step, as GenApp's design allows

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: IF EIBCALEN IS EQUAL TO ZERO -- EM-VARIABLE ' NO COMMAREA RECEIVED', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ with ERROR-MSG (it writes the message to TD CSMT and TS GENAERRS: #4607), IF EIBCALEN > 0 is false, then ABEND LGCA

scenarios.name: update-fails-deadlock
scenarios.why: SQLCODE -913 on the UPDATE: not +100, so '90' and WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ; LGUCVS01 still runs

notes: Generated-row sibling (#4507) of genapp-lgucdb01: the ten CUSTOMER rows (numbers 1..10) are generated from base/cntl/db2cre.jcl, not GenApp's INSERTs; LGUCDB01 only writes them (UPDATE ... WHERE CUSTOMERNUMBER), so every column keeps its generated NULLs and boundary values. 16 generated requests draw CA-CUSTOMER-NUM from the generated numbers (a quarter of the time one the rows do not hold: +100, '01'), the update fields from four stated records and the request id varied (never tested by the program). LGUCVS01 rewrites KSDSCUST (ksdscust.txt, customers 1..10; customer 11 on VSAM only). Stated, not generated: EIBCALEN 0, customer 11, a 100-byte email and an injected -913 / -811 on the UPDATE (line 155, sqlstate given: '90', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ, its second WRITEQ is written padded, X6, so the whole task is compared).
